<span class="hl-kw">from</span> __future__ <span class="hl-kw">import</span> annotations
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> dataclasses <span class="hl-kw">import</span> dataclass


<span class="hl-comment">@dataclass(frozen=True)</span>
<span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData:
    count: <span class="hl-type">int</span>
    ratio: <span class="hl-type">float</span>
    opt_count: <span class="hl-type">int</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    opt_ratio: <span class="hl-type">float</span> | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    ints: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">int</span>] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    nums: <span class="hl-type">list</span>[<span class="hl-type">float</span>] | <span class="hl-kw">None</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>

    @classmethod
    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> from_dict(<span class="hl-kw">cls</span>, data: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]) -&gt; UserCreatedData:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">cls</span>(
            count=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;count&quot;</span>),
            ratio=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;ratio&quot;</span>),
            opt_count=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;optCount&quot;</span>),
            opt_ratio=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;optRatio&quot;</span>),
            ints=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;ints&quot;</span>),
            nums=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nums&quot;</span>),
        )

    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> to_dict(<span class="hl-kw">self</span>) -&gt; <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> {
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;count&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.count,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;ratio&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.ratio,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;optCount&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.opt_count,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;optRatio&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.opt_ratio,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;ints&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.ints,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;nums&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.nums,
        }
